**q25.** Engine: CEL (Google `cel-go v0.28.1`, `go.mod:13`) via the in-repo memo filter engine at `internal/filter/` (entry `filter.DefaultEngine()`, `internal/filter/engine.go`; schema `schema.go`, CEL→IR `parser.go`/`ir.go`, SQL rendering `render.go`, docs `README.md`). Mechanism: the handler validates the filter (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_filter.go`) and passes it as `FindMemo.Filters`; each dialect driver calls `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, filter.DialectSQLite|DialectMySQL|DialectPostgres, &where, &args)` (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9`, `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go`), which compiles the CEL AST to a dialect-specific parameterized SQL fragment (`render.go` handles JSON access, placeholders, `LIKE`/`ILIKE`) that is appended to the WHERE clause.

**q26.**
```
memo_relation  (store/memo.go:142,145 — both directions)
attachment     (store/memo.go:148-156 via Store.DeleteAttachment, store/attachment.go:132)
memo           (store/memo.go:157 — the memo row; also comment memo rows, deleted recursively by the handler at server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:573-577)
memo_share     (DB-level FOREIGN KEY ... ON DELETE CASCADE — store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:109, postgres/LATEST.sql:108, mysql/LATEST.sql:108)
```
Caveats: `memo_share` cascade is schema-level, not code; on SQLite it does not actually fire because the driver opens with `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`). `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:545`) but are never deleted.

**q27.** Mechanism: the built SPA is embedded into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by an Echo static/SPA-fallback handler. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (embed), `:41` (`FrontendService.Serve`, `getFileSystem("dist")` at `:116`), called from `server/server.go:70`. The build output is placed there by `cd web && pnpm release` (per `AGENTS.md`), i.e. `server/router/frontend/dist`.

**q28.**
```
s3presign.Runner — server/runner/s3presign/runner.go: RunOnce at startup + time.Ticker every 12h (runnerInterval, runner.go:27-41); started in server/server.go:148-166 (startBackgroundRunners)
internal/webhook async dispatch workers — 4 goroutines started by package init() consuming a 128-slot channel (internal/webhook/webhook.go:39-55), fed by webhook.PostAsync (event-driven, not scheduled)
```
Unused infra: `internal/scheduler` (a full cron/job scheduler with parser, middleware, jobs) is **not** referenced anywhere outside its own tests (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go`, `integration_test.go`). Also `server/runner/memopayload` lives under `server/runner/` but is not a background runner — it is called inline from the API layer (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:18,108`).

**q29.**
```
interceptor — web/src/connect.ts:148 (authInterceptor), installed on the shared transport at :173-178; token state in web/src/auth-state.ts
token kinds — short-lived JWT access token (localStorage, sent as "Authorization: Bearer <token>"; proactive refresh on expiry + reactive retry on Unauthenticated, connect.ts:118-145,148-170) and an httpOnly refresh-token cookie (sent via credentials: "include", connect.ts:57-62; refreshed through AuthService.RefreshToken on a separate interceptor-free transport, :65-80). Backend also accepts personal access tokens (PATs).
backend package — server/auth (Authenticator: AuthenticateByAccessTokenV2 / AuthenticateByRefreshToken / AuthenticateByPAT, server/auth/authenticator.go:41,61,102; JWT parsing in server/auth/token.go:220,236), invoked from server/router/api/v1/authz.go and the gateway middleware / Connect interceptors in server/router/api/v1/v1.go:69-92,133-144
```

**q30.**
```
memo created: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook ("memos.memo.created") — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15, called at memo_service.go:157
memo updated: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook ("memos.memo.updated") — memo_service_webhooks.go:20, called at memo_update_helpers.go:67
memo deleted: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook ("memos.memo.deleted") — memo_service_webhooks.go:25, called at memo_service.go:562
memo comment created: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook ("memos.memo.comment.created") — memo_service_webhooks.go:30, called at memo_service_comments.go:119
```
The first three converge on `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four then converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` / `:120` for HTTP delivery.
